# Darwin Theme

> Darwin is a dark, translucent, Mac-like desktop theme for KDE Plasma 6 (Wayland and X11) and LXQt / Lubuntu. It adds a slim top bar, a floating dock with icon magnification, a Spotlight-style search launcher (apps, files, calculator, currency), an Alt+Tab window switcher, traffic-light window buttons, rounded windows, WhiteSur icons and the Inter font. One command installs it, every change is backed up, and `./restore.sh` undoes it.

Keywords: Mac-like Linux desktop theme, KDE Plasma 6 theme, dock with magnification KDE, Spotlight alternative KDE, LXQt theme, Lubuntu theme, WhiteSur, Wayland, Kubuntu.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): features, requirements (KDE tooling table), install, settings, troubleshooting, FAQ
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): rules, how to run the tests, how to report a problem

## Install
```
git clone https://github.com/prashantjain25/darwin-theme.git
cd darwin-theme
./install.sh --dry-run
./install.sh
```
Undo with `./restore.sh`. Add `--install-deps` to fetch missing themes, fonts and the rounded-corners effect.

## Key files
- `install.sh`, `dock.sh`, `restore.sh`: entry points; they detect KDE or LXQt
- `lib/kde.py`: KDE installer (files, settings, panels, backup and restore)
- `assets/plasmoids/com.prashantjain25.darwin.dock`: the dock (Plasma widget)
- `assets/spotlight`: the search launcher (Qt)
- `assets/tabbox`: the Alt+Tab switcher
- `config/theme.default.json`: all settings
